guard_pose: relaxed menacing stance facing right, upright in a white kimono with a dark sash, one arm hanging at his side, the other hand held open forward at waist height, palm up

jab: contemptuous jab: snaps the open front hand straight forward into a fast backhand strike, then lets it drift back open into the relaxed stance
jab2: fast cross punch: throws the other fist straight forward with a twist of the hips, then back into the relaxed stance
jab3: brutal front kick: lifts the front knee and kicks straight forward at belly height with a flash of crimson cursed energy, then back into the stance
dashattack: lunging knee: rushes forward and drives a flying knee straight ahead with a burst of crimson cursed energy, kimono flaring, then lands and stands back up in the relaxed stance
fsmash: slashing chop: draws the open hand far back, then swipes it forward at full extension like a blade, thin crimson slash lines flashing just in front of his hand, then recovers into the relaxed stance
usmash: rising slash: crouches slightly, then springs up and swipes the open hand straight up above his head, thin crimson slash lines flashing above him, then lands back in the stance
dsmash: low split kicks: drops low and kicks fast in front at foot level, then spins and kicks behind him, crimson slash lines flashing at each foot, then back into the stance
nair: neutral aerial: spins once in mid-air, kimono flaring, as thin crimson slash lines flash in a ring around his body, then opens up again
fair: forward aerial: a powerful flying kick straight forward in mid-air with a burst of crimson cursed energy at the foot, then pulls the leg back in
dair: down aerial: stomps straight down beneath him with both feet in mid-air with a burst of crimson cursed energy, then pulls the legs back up

nspecial: Dismantle: flicks his open hand forward in a quick sideways swipe, two thin crimson slash lines shoot straight out ahead of him in a narrow fan, then he lowers the hand back into the relaxed stance
sspecial: Cleave: lunges forward and slashes rapidly with his open hand held like a blade, three fast cuts leaving crimson slash streaks in front of him, then a final heavy downward chop with a burst of crimson cursed energy, then settles back into the relaxed stance
uspecial: cursed rising uppercut: crouches, then springs straight up driving his fist up above his head, crimson cursed energy trailing the arm and kimono flaring below him, ending high in mid-air with the arm raised
dspecial: Fuga: holds both hands apart in front of his chest and flames ignite between them, the fire stretches into a blazing arrow held between his hands, he pulls it back beside his face with the rear hand as if drawing a bowstring with no bow at all, then releases and the flaming arrow shoots straight forward, then he lowers his hands into the relaxed stance
ultimate: Domain Expansion, Malevolent Shrine: brings both hands together in front of his chest in the domain hand sign, fingers interlocked with the index fingers pointing up, a dark red aura swells around him, countless thin crimson slash lines flash all around his body in every direction, faster and faster, then he spreads his arms as a burst of flame erupts around him, then the flames die down and he returns to the relaxed stance
w0_nspecial: Kamutoke: a long dark lance with a golden crescent near its tip appears in his hand in a crackle of lightning, he raises it overhead, then points it forward and a bolt of white-blue lightning shoots straight ahead from its tip, then the lance fades away in sparks and he returns to the relaxed stance
w0_ultimate: Kamutoke: a long dark lance with a golden crescent near its tip appears in his hand, he raises it high above his head, white-blue lightning crackles down onto its tip and flashes around him three times, the lance flaring at each strike, then he thrusts it higher for one final huge flash of lightning, then lowers it, the lance fades away in sparks and he returns to the relaxed stance
w1_ultimate: Open, Fuga: flames ignite in both his open hands, he holds the hands apart in front of his chest and the fire stretches into a long blazing arrow between them, he draws it back beside his face with the rear hand as if pulling a bowstring with no bow at all, flames roaring around his arms, holds the aim, then releases and the flaming arrow shoots straight forward with a burst of fire, then the flames die down and he returns to the relaxed stance

walk: walks forward unhurriedly to the right in side profile, one arm hanging, the other hand open at waist height: the back leg steps past the front leg, then the other, the body and head stay turned to the right the whole time exactly like the first frame, a seamless two-step walk cycle that ends exactly on the first pose
crouch: squats down very low on the spot: knees fully bent, hips dropped almost to the heels, back bent forward, arms loose
